theme: Light theme (base background #F9F9F6) to convey elegance, organization, and a premium B2B SaaS feel.

typography.primary: Cabinet Grotesk (Use for headings, numbers, and key UI labels)
typography.secondary: Satoshi (Use for body text, table cells, and descriptions)

hierarchy.h1_page_title: text-2xl or text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900

colors.brand_accent_note: Terracotta - Use sparingly for CTAs, active states, and important highlights to maintain elegance.

visual_enhancers.corners: Move from 0px brutalist to soft rounded corners. Cards: rounded-xl. Buttons/Inputs: rounded-lg. Badges: rounded-full.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Extremely subtle. Use shadow-sm for cards. shadow-md for dropdowns/modals. Drop heavy brutalist borders.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-slate-200 on cards and sidebars to define edges without heaviness.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid heavy glass. Use backdrop-blur-md with bg-white/80 only for sticky headers/topbars if needed. No transparent backgrounds over content.

layouts.app_shell: Left Sidebar (staff: w-64, responsive) + Main Content Area. Topbar minimal (breadcrumbs or user profile).
layouts.spacing: Generous. p-6 or p-8 inside cards. gap-6 in grids.
layouts.dashboard: 4 KPI Cards top row. Then an asymmetrical grid (e.g., col-span-8 for chart, col-span-4 for recent activity feed).
layouts.client_portal: Minimalist single column, max-w-5xl mx-auto, high top margin (mt-12 or mt-20) to feel like a premium launchpad.

buttons.primary: bg-[#D95D39] text-white hover:bg-[#c24b2b] rounded-lg px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-all shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-all

components.cards: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden
components.tables: w-full text-left text-sm. Headers: border-b border-slate-200 text-slate-500 font-medium py-3. Rows: border-b border-slate-100 py-3 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50/50 transition-colors.
components.sidebar_items: flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2 rounded-md text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors. Active state: bg-[#D95D39]/10 text-[#D95D39] (Terracotta).
components.badges: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium
components.inputs: w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D95D39]/20 focus:border-[#D95D39]
components.module_catalog_card: flex flex-col p-5 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl bg-white hover:shadow-md transition-all. Top: Icon inside a soft bg-[#D95D39]/10 rounded-lg text-[#D95D39] w-fit p-2. Content: Title + Description. Bottom: Status badge + Action Button.

motion.hover_states: Micro-interactions: Buttons slightly scale down on click (active:scale-[0.98]). Cards elevate slightly on hover (hover:-translate-y-[2px] hover:shadow-md) with duration-200 ease-out.
motion.loading: Use soft skeleton pulses (animate-pulse bg-slate-200) instead of heavy spinners where possible.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure Terracotta text on light backgrounds passes WCAG AA.
accessibility.focus: All focusable elements must have focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#D95D39]/50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-offset-1.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are modifying `.js` files, not `.tsx`. Ensure JSX syntax is standard for JS files.
CRITICAL: PRESERVE ALL `data-testid` attributes. Do not remove them.
CRITICAL: Do NOT change the existing logic, especially the 'Abrir módulo' handoff integration.
Remove or override old `.dh-*` brutalist classes (e.g., 2px solid borders, no-radius) with the new Tailwind utility classes (rounded-xl, border-slate-200, shadow-sm, softer colors).
Use `lucide-react` for all icons. Standardize strokeWidth to 1.5 or 2.
Implement an empty state standard for tables and lists: an icon (lucide), a muted text message, and optionally a CTA to create.
Ensure the application is fully responsive. Sidebar should be a drawer/hamburger on mobile.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts for the whole app. Use standard SaaS left-sidebar layout for Staff, and centered max-w layout ONLY for the Client Portal.
Do not apply `transition: all`. Specify `transition-colors`, `transition-transform`, etc.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters. Use lucide-react icons.
Keep the aesthetic clean and uncluttered. Let the #F9F9F6 background provide breathing room around the #FFFFFF cards.
